action.message:
Implemented transaction handling for Changelist list_editable processing in django/contrib/admin/options.py.

Change: In ModelAdmin.changelist_view, the bulk-edit loop that saves each changed form (save_form/save_model/save_related/log_change) is now wrapped in `with transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model)):`, so all list_editable edits commit or roll back as a single unit. Both `transaction` and `router` were already imported from django.db.

Verification: scoped_tests passed — 74 tests ran with 0 failures (admin_changelist selection).

tool_call.name: finish

summary: Wrapped list_editable bulk edit in transaction.atomic
